name: Allan Nance
source:
Juliet's father has a bear-like appearance but beneath the surface hides a big heart.
He has never really recovered from the death of his wife in a car accident and since then can become quite moody for no apparent reason.
Very protective of Juliet, sometimes a bit stuffy.
